calibrationEvidence.note: Owned typical Node CRUD fit from typical-v1-20260927c (engine 1.2.3, fit rungs typical-fit-20, typical-fit-100, typical-fit-200); one day and one region, 20–200 RPS fit, 300 RPS independent holdout. Scaled from the typical-v1 two-server fit to 3 app servers using equivalent two-server fit load 200 RPS; this server count was not measured. Pool-capacity warning: the three application pools total 750 connections versus MySQL max_connections=500; the database limit is lower than combined pool capacity. This declared mismatch alone does not add errors or reduce throughput. Cost is list price, not a measured bill.
calibrationEvidence.latencyBasis: P50/P99 scaled from the owned typical two-server fit; not measured by typical-v1 at this server count. P95 uses typical-p95-v1, validated on independent holdouts (not fit data): m5.large, 1–3 app servers, 100–300 total RPS, at most 300 RPS per node, db.r5.large. Holdout DB CPU stayed at or below about 28% with no connection errors. Not validated below 100 or above 300 total RPS or under database saturation. The 300 total-RPS cap and linear per-node extension above 300 RPS are extrapolations, not measurements. Evidence: https://github.com/canvascloudai/cwm-bench/pull/21.
calibrationEvidence.latencyP99Basis: owned typical in-VPC k6 P99 fit (unweighted diagnostic)

predictionEvidence.note: P95 uses typical-p95-v1, validated on independent holdouts (not fit data): m5.large, 1–3 app servers, 100–300 total RPS, at most 300 RPS per node, db.r5.large. Holdout DB CPU stayed at or below about 28% with no connection errors. Not validated below 100 or above 300 total RPS or under database saturation. The 300 total-RPS cap and linear per-node extension above 300 RPS are extrapolations, not measurements. Evidence: https://github.com/canvascloudai/cwm-bench/pull/21. The following original typical-v1 fit notes describe non-P95 metrics only. typical application; basis provenance, not observed simulated output. Assumption intervals, not statistical confidence intervals. The source typical-v1 fit was measured on the two-server topology at 20/100/200 RPS, with 300 RPS as an independent holdout. Scaled from the typical-v1 two-server fit to 3 app servers using equivalent two-server fit load 200 RPS; this server count was not measured. Pool-capacity warning: the three application pools total 750 connections versus MySQL max_connections=500; the database limit is lower than combined pool capacity. This declared mismatch alone does not add errors or reduce throughput. Assumed in-VPC/internal-LB baseline; other provider/network paths are not measured. P99: owned typical in-VPC k6 P99 fit (unweighted diagnostic); typical fit uses only 20/100/200 RPS; 300 RPS is an independent holdout; 500 RPS is a diagnostic extrapolation, neither used to fit.
